claim: Statin therapy reduces the risk of major cardiovascular events in adults with cardiovascular risk factors.
Hydroxychloroquine treatment reduces mortality in hospitalized COVID-19 patients.
Higher coffee consumption is associated with a reduced risk of developing type 2 diabetes.
Vitamin E supplementation reduces the risk of prostate cancer in healthy men.
Omega-3 fatty acid supplements prevent the onset of dementia in older adults.
Following a Mediterranean diet lowers the risk of major cardiovascular events in adults at high cardiovascular risk.
